page: Google Cloud Platform ct5p-hightpu-1t is an accelerator-optimized instance from the TPU Machines family. It features 52 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs paired with 112 GB of system memory, providing approximately 2.15 GB of RAM per vCPU. The core component of the configuration is a single Google TPU v5p accelerator equipped with 95 GB of specialized accelerator memory.

The instance does not include integrated local storage, requiring network-attached storage solutions for operating system images, model checkpoints, and data pipelines. Additionally, it provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, necessitating VPC network configurations or external gateways for public network routing.

The ct5p-hightpu-1t is built for specialized artificial intelligence and machine learning workloads, including deep learning model training, fine-tuning large language models, and high-throughput tensor-based inference. By pairing a high-capacity TPU v5p accelerator with dedicated host resources, it provides efficient compute utilization for AI development workflows without the operational overhead of multi-accelerator pods.
description: Google Cloud Platform ct5p-hightpu-1t is an accelerator-focused instance within the TPU Machines family, designed specifically for machine learning and deep learning workloads. The host configuration delivers 52 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs and 112 GB of system RAM, maintaining a memory allocation of 2.15 GB per core. Acceleration is provided by a single integrated Google TPU v5p chip featuring 95 GB of high-bandwidth memory. The instance does not include local disk storage, necessitating persistent network volumes for datasets and system software. In addition, no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are provisioned by default. Designed to maximize tensor calculation efficiency, the ct5p-hightpu-1t suits large language model fine-tuning, complex neural network training, and intensive inference workloads that benefit from Google Cloud TPU architecture.
